description.value: Cit-E Cycles is BC's largest e-bike retailer, founded in 2011 from a single Langley shop and now operating six locations across the province. Their North Vancouver store carries 300+ models from 20+ premium brands spanning urban, cargo, mountain, and touring styles. Touring cyclists will find one of the broadest e-bike selections in Canada, with in-store test rides and dedicated service support.

address.value: 3030 Saint Johns Street, North Vancouver, BC
